hypotheses.title: Agent reliability is the next capability frontier
hypotheses.claim: As raw capability plateaus, the competitive gap opens around reliability, consistency, and verifiability of agent behavior — not raw performance.

evidence_for.summary: Self-improving agents are fragile under variance and task reordering
LLM preference judgments are not self-consistent — cannot be reproduced by a single coherent utility function
API model migrations hide item-level regressions behind aggregate scores

hypotheses.implications: Products that instrument, audit, and guarantee agent behavior will command premium trust. Relevant to Paperclip's autonomous company stack.

hypotheses.title: Agent memory is commoditizing into middleware
hypotheses.claim: Persistent cross-session memory is consolidating from a product differentiator into a standardized infrastructure layer.

evidence_for.summary: claude-mem (91k stars), mem0 (63k stars) and multiple harness projects all targeting the same layer

hypotheses.implications: Build above the memory layer, not at it. Memory-as-a-product plays are likely to be commoditized.

hypotheses.title: Versioned workspaces will define agent auditability
hypotheses.claim: Agents need explicit state management (git-like workspace awareness) to be auditable, rollback-capable, and trusted in knowledge work.

evidence_for.summary: StagedWorkspace — agents editing documents need explicit workspace-state contracts

hypotheses.implications: "Git for agent workspaces" is an entire product category waiting. Early movers define audit/trust standards.
